format: 90-second silent, captioned walkthrough of captured synthetic output; not a real-time screen recording

scenes.caption:
GenAI traces become bounded metrics in your existing telemetry pipeline.
This is the actual Grafana demo, running on synthetic traffic.

Compare model-request rate, reported token rate, and missing usage.
Model names are cleartext labels. Prompt hashes are not metric labels.

The investigation sends 100 agent runs with one tool call each.
Then it sends 100 more runs with eight tool calls each.

400 spans become 1,100 spans. Model requests stay at 100.
The collector counts model operations, not every span in a trace.

Now omit usage fields on half the model requests.
Reported tokens fall by half; known synthetic consumption stays the same.

Missing usage rises to 50 of 100 requests. Missing is not zero.
Try it: sh examples/demo.sh up, then sh examples/demo.sh investigate
